subject: Calgary Core Physiotherapy
text:
Hi Calgary Core team,

638 five-star Google reviews, many from patients who had bad luck at other clinics before finding Dylan and Tim. That is rare.

I run a small team in London that helps clinics turn that kind of reputation into more booked appointments. We sketched a homepage idea for Calgary Core and compared you with the physio clinics nearby.

Would you like me to send it over?

Best regards,
Mostafa
